paite: Huan adakkhia a, mihaute'n sumkholna a sum akhiak lai uh amu hi.
heading: Meithainu Thilpiak / (Mar 12.41-44)
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

paite: Meithai zawngtak kuahiam in dal dangka muza nih hong khia leng amu hi.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

paite: Huchi in "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, hiai tengteng sang in tua meithai zawngtak in akhe tamzaw.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

paite: Hiai tengteng in aneihlet uh akhia ua; ama'n bel akitunhingna ding a aneih sunsun akhe vek hi," achi hi.
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

paite: Huan kuate hiam in tempul thu, suang hoihtak leh thil piakkhawm a azep kilawmdan uh, agen lai un, ama'n,
heading: Hun Tawp Chiamtehnate / (Mat 24.1-2; Mar 13.1-4)
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

paite: "Hiai na thil muh uh, hihchip louh a suang kichiang himhim hiai a a-om louh ding nite ahong tung ding hi," achi hi.
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

paite: 7 Huan amau akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huaite chikchiang in ahong om ding ua? Huaite ahong tun ding chiamtehna bang a-om dia?" chi in adong uhi.
heading: Khrist Hong Paina Ding Chiamtehna / (Mat 24.3-14; Mar 13.3-13)
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

paite: Huan ama'n, "Pimang a na omlouhna ding un pilvang un. Mi tampi'n, 'Khrist ka hi!' huan, 'Ahun tung ding ahita, chi in keimah min sial in ahong pai ding uh, huaite zui kei un.'
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

paite: Kidou thu leh buai thu na zak hun chiang un lau kei un; huaite atung masa ding a, tawpna bel hi pah lou ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

paite: Akiang uah, "Nam tuam leh nam tuam akidou ding ua, gam tuam leh gam tuam akidou ding uh.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

paite: 'Nakpitak in ziin aling dia, mun tuamtuam ah kial ake ding a, hipi aleng lai ding; van a kipan thil lauhuai leh chiamtehna thupitak ahong om ding hi.'
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

paite: Himahleh huai thil tengteng atun ma in, nou ahon man ding ua, sinagog leh suangkul ah pi in ahon hihgim ding uh, keimah min ziak in kumpipate leh gamukte ma ah ahon pi ding uhi.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

paite: Hiai noute a ding a theihpihna hun lemtang ahi ding hi.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

paite: Huchi in dawnna ding ngaihtuah khawl lou ding in na lungtang uah kihihkip un.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

paite: Na melma tengteng un hon dou ua hon sel theihlouhna ding un kam leh pilna ka hon pe ding hi.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

paite: Huan na nu leh na pate, na unaute, na tanaute, na lawmte un leng hon mansak ding ua; akhen ahon that ding uhi.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

paite: Keimah min ziak in mi tengteng huat na hi ding uh.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

paite: Himahleh, na samzang uh khat leng amangthang kei ding.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

paite: Na kuhkalna uah na hinna uh na humbit ding uhi.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

paite: "Himahleh sepaihte'n Jerusalem khua a-um uh na muh chiang un, amangthang dek chih thei un.
heading: Jerusalem Siatna Ding Genkholhna / (Mat 24.15-21; Mar 13.14-19)
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Judia gam a omte'n tang ah taimangsan uhen; asung a omte'n pawtsan uhen, gam a omte asung ah lut kei uhen.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

paite: Huai nite phulakna ahi; thu agelh tengteng uh ahong tuntheihna ding in.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

paite: Huai nite in gaite leh naunou pomte tung agik ding, khovel ah haksatna thupitak atun ding ziak in leh hiai chite tung a thangpaihna atun ding ziak in.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

paite: Huan namsau in asi ding ua, nam chih kiang ah sal a pi in a-om ding uh; huan Jerusalem tuh Zentelte ni atawp mateng Zentelte sikden in a-om ding hi.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

paite: "Huan ni leh kha leh aksite ah, chiamtehna a-om ding a; tuipi mau leh akihoh ziak in leitung ah leng namte haksatna leh mangbatna atung ding;
heading: Toupa Hong Pai Nihveina / (Mat 24.29-31; Mar 13.24-27)
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

paite: mite launa ziak leh khovel a thil hong tung ding ngaihtuah ziak in, asibup ding ua; van thilhihtheihnate aling ding hi.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Mihing Tapa thilhihtheihna leh thupina thupi toh meipi lak a hong pai amu ding uhi.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

paite: Huan huai thilte ahong tun pat hun chiang in entou unla, dakkhia un; na tatna uh ahong nai tak ziak in," achi hi.
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

paite: Huan akiang uah gentehna thu agen a, "Theipi kung leh sing tengteng en un;
heading: Theipi Kung Gentehna / (Mat 24.32-35; Mar 13.28-31)
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

paite: ahong selnoutak in huai na mu ua, nipi hong tung ding ahita, chih noumau in na thei uhi.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

paite: Huchi mah bang in nou leng huaite hong tung na muh chiang un, Pathian lalgam ahong naita chih thei un.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, thil tengteng atunkim masiah hiai khangte amang kei ding hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

paite: Lei leh van amang dia, ka thu bel amang kei ding hi.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

paite: "Himahleh pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw nekvah luat toh, zukham toh damsung khosak ngaihtuah in, na lungtang uh adim lo kha ding a, huai ni in thang-awk bang in thakhat in na tung uah ahong tung guih kha ding hi.
heading: Kiveng Gige A Om Akulna / (Mat 24.36-44; Mar 13.32-37)
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

paite: Huchi bangtak a leitung maikaih a omte tengteng tung a tung chiat ding ahi ngal a.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Huai thil hong tung ding tengteng pel ding leh Mihing Tapa ma a dingh tak ding a seh na hihtheihna ding uleh thahatna na neihna ding un chik lai peuh in thum kawm in limsak gige un," achi hi.
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

paite: Huan niteng in tempul ah thu ahilh zel a; zan teng in apawt a, Olive tang achih uah agiak zel hi.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

paite: Huan zing in athu ngaikhe ding in mi tengteng tempul ah akiang ah ahong zel uhi.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
